args.body: Finish the existing CATALOGUE-COMMISSION-TERMS-PROPOSAL as a copy-ready operator decision packet linked to the verified inbound replies at products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad/operator-reply-packet.json. Buyer confirmation, administrative acceptance and settlement each require separate evidence. Close under valid ownership after readback with a lesson. No external send or payment instructions.
